question: Nirupama Sanjeev is a famous _____ player of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**tennis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• Nirupama Sanjeev is one of the first Indian women to win a round at a Grand Slam tournament.

• She achieved this milestone at the 1998 Australian Open.

• Nirupama has represented India in several international tennis competitions including the Fed Cup.

• She has been a significant figure in Indian tennis, inspiring many young athletes to pursue the sport.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Tennis:**

• Tennis is a racket sport that can be played individually against a single opponent or between two teams of two players each.

• The modern game of tennis originated in Birmingham, England, in the late 19th century as lawn tennis.

• The four Grand Slam tournaments are the most prestigious events in tennis: the Australian Open, the French Open, Wimbledon, and the US Open.

• India has produced several notable tennis players, including Leander Paes, Mahesh Bhupathi, Sania Mirza, and Rohan Bopanna.

• **Badminton:**

• Badminton is a racquet sport played using racquets to hit a shuttlecock across a net.

• It is commonly played as a casual outdoor activity in a yard or on a beach; formal games are played on a rectangular indoor court.

• India has a rich history in badminton, with players like Prakash Padukone, Pullela Gopichand, Saina Nehwal, and PV Sindhu achieving international success.

• **Swimming:**

• Swimming is an individual or team racing sport that requires the use of one's entire body to move through water.

• The sport takes place in pools or open water (e.g., in a sea or lake).

• India has been making strides in swimming, with swimmers like Virdhawal Khade and Sajan Prakash gaining recognition.

• **Chess:**

• Chess is a board game played between two players. It is sometimes called Western or international chess to distinguish it from related games such as xiangqi.

• The current form of the game emerged in Southern Europe during the second half of the 15th century after evolving from a similar, much older game of Indian origin.

• India has a strong presence in the world of chess, with Viswanathan Anand being a former World Chess Champion and a grandmaster.
